svg.title: Планка на предплечьях с отягощением — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One full-body three-quarter side view of a weighted forearm plank. Both forearms flat on floor, elbows stacked under shoulders, both toes on floor, body straight from head to heels. ONE clearly recognizable round gym weight plate with central hole lies FLAT horizontally on the upper/mid back between shoulder blades, visibly resting on body, not against waist and not on the floor. No hands holding the disk, no bench, no machine, no second figure. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
